title: 一部勝訴
contents: 判決文を入手できていませんが、東京地裁は1日の判決で、こちらの主張を一部認めました。赤木ファイルの保管状況については私の請求内容で文書を特定できるとして財務省の主張を退けた模様です。
contents_en: Although the text of the judgment is not available, the Tokyo District Court partially accepted our argument in its ruling on the 1st. Regarding the storage status of the Akagi file, it appears that the Ministry of Finance has rejected the claim, stating that the document can be identified based on the contents of my request.
